meta.name: welcome
meta.description: Introduce yourself to a newly connected channel. Triggered automatically when a channel is first wired. Send a friendly greeting and brief overview of what you can do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动向新连接频道发送欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在频道首次连接时自动打招呼
copy.tagline_en: Automatically send a welcome message to newly connected channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an automatic greeting when a channel is first wired

howto.what: 当连接到新频道时，Claude 会发送一条友好的自我介绍，简要说明它能做什么，并询问用户是想探索能力还是直接开始。
howto.when: 当 Claude 首次连接到一个新频道时自动触发。

say.text: 你好，我是 Claude，很高兴认识你！想看看我能做什么吗？
say.note: 触发自我介绍和功能探索流程。

say.text: 直接开始吧，我需要你帮我写一份报告。
say.note: 跳过介绍，直接进入任务模式。

howto.what_en: When connected to a new channel, Claude sends a friendly greeting, briefly introduces its capabilities, and asks if the user wants to explore or jump straight in.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically when Claude is first connected to a new channel.

say_en.text: Hi, I'm Claude. Nice to meet you! Want to see what I can do?
Let's jump in. I need help writing a report.
say_en.note: Skips introduction, goes straight to task mode.
